summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled systemd service inventory-worker on node1. It runs under the dedicated non-login inventorysvc system account and recovered automatically after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with UID/GID 996, /nonexistent home, and /sbin/nologin shell.
Configured systemd failure recovery and service hardening.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service, account, configuration, and live worker process persisted after restart.

evidence.requirement: Run os-comparison-worker as the managed inventory-worker service under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: Shows the service enabled and active, ExecStart pointing to /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, User/Group set to inventorysvc, and the live process parented by systemd.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 6bb7e004-1e2e-46ac-bfd7-fafa248a4e76, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 1d52b090-f2a9-43db-ad71-538192e2ae2f, and recovered system/service state with a new live worker PID.
